rationale: Both bring deep expertise in embodied AI and robotics from complementary angles—Shan leads Ruyi Dynamics' hardware-software integration for industrial deployment, while You Liang combines NVIDIA's generalist humanoid robot research with classical robotics fundamentals (SLAM, motion planning) and open-source infrastructure work. Their shared conviction that embodied AI requires bridging research breakthroughs with real-world deployment could spark valuable discussion on scaling robot learning from lab to production.
intro_message: Shan, meet You Liang Tan—he's building generalist robot foundation models at NVIDIA GEAR and has deep experience scaling robotics from research to industry, which could be highly relevant to Ruyi Dynamics' work deploying embodied AI in commercial environments.
